subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Semester review: Grammar reference, Solve it and Progress path
outcomes: Remember the main grammar of Units 1–4.
Choose the correct grammar form in sentences.
Check your progress and set a goal for next semester.

tf.s: "Hamed is the best tennis player in the class." is correct.
"When I was one, I could walk, but I couldn't talk." uses could for the past.
The negative of "I will get him a book." is "I don't will get him a book."
tf.why: The negative is: I won't get him a book.

tf.s: "He has to get some pocket money." is correct.
tf.why: With he we use has to.
We use who for people and which for things.

tf.s: "It's the shop where my brother works." is correct.
tf.why: A shop is a place, so we use where.

tf.s: A planet is something people make.
tf.why: A planet is natural. Satellites, space stations and rockets are made by people.

tf.s: "I visited my grandma yesterday." is in the past simple.
tf.why: visited is the past simple of visit.

tf.s: We ask about the depth of a sea with "How deep …?"
tf.why: How deep is the Sea of Oman?

boxes.q: Complete: Hamed is the ______ (good) tennis player in the class.
Complete: When I was one, I ______ walk, but I couldn't talk.
Make it negative: I will get him a book.
o: I won't get him a book.
I willn't get him a book.
I not will get him a book.

boxes.q: Complete: He ______ get some pocket money. (have to)
Choose: It's the shop (who / which / where) my brother works.
Circle the odd one out: satellite, planet, space station, rocket.
boxes.why: A planet is natural; the others are made by people.

boxes.q: Which unit grammar is "who / which / where"?
boxes.why: who, which and where make relative clauses.

boxes.q: Complete: Before I go to school, I ______ breakfast.
boxes.why: We use the present simple for routines.

boxes.q: Which sentence is about the future?
o: I could play football when I was six.
boxes.why: I'll = I will, for the future.

mcq.why: Unit 3 has will / won't and How …?

o: who / which / where and have to
mcq.why: Unit 4 has relative clauses and have to.

mcq.q: Which sentence uses be good at correctly?

o: Now I can … I need to work more on …
It's the man who we saw.
mcq.why: We say what we can do and what we need to practise.

mcq.q: Write one sentence with have to.
o: I have to do my homework.
I has to do my homework.
I have to doing my homework.
I having to do my homework.

mcq.q: What could you do when you were five? Choose the correct answer.
o: I could ride a bike, but I couldn't swim.
I can ride a bike, but I can't swam.
I will ride a bike when I was five.
mcq.why: could + base verb for the past.

mcq.q: Describe your friend in one sentence.
o: She's got long, dark hair and she's very kind.
She's got long, dark hair and she very kind.
mcq.why: She's got + appearance, and she's + personality.

o: He has to get some pocket money.
That's the woman who works at the shop.
mcq.why: After will we use the base verb: will send.

mcq.q: "I can describe people well. I need to work more on the past simple." What is this student doing?
mcq.why: They say what they can do and what to practise.

mcq.q: Which sentence compares two people correctly?
o: Ali is more tall than Omar.
Ali is the taller than Omar.
mcq.why: For two people we use -er than.
